title.en: Tale 3 — The Pot That Gave Birth

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: جحا استعار طنجرة كبيرة من جاره.
sentences.en: Juha borrowed a big pot from his neighbour.

sentences.ar: لما رجعها، حط جواتها طنجرة زغيرة.
sentences.en: When he returned it, he put a small pot inside it.
The neighbour said: what is this small one?
Juha said: your pot gave birth.
The neighbour was happy and took both.

sentences.ar: بعد أسبوع، استعار الطنجرة كمان مرة.
sentences.en: A week later, he borrowed the pot again.
This time he did not return it.

sentences.ar: سأله الجار عنها، قال له: ماتت.
sentences.en: The neighbour asked about it; he said: it died.
The neighbour said: pots do not die!
Juha said: you believed it gives birth.
And you do not believe it dies?
